items.rationale: The battery health waiver is on the schedule, so 2.6.8 does not bite and the gateway is passed. The repair is uneconomic per the supplier report, so 7.1.10 pays the acquisition amount of an equivalent unit; no deductible or sub-limit figure is given.
7.1.9: the difference for a higher specification is borne by the policyholder and is not indemnified under any head.
Under 2.6.4 a second unit hit in the same event is assessed on its own, and 2.6.3(a) covers screen breakage; priced at a typical installed tablet screen repair rate.
5.2.3 covers examination of each affected unit, payable even where the repair is uneconomic, capped at EUR 250 per event. Estimate based on the comparable diagnostic rate in Case 2.
4.2.6 and 7.1.5: an accessory or case not itself damaged is not indemnified.
3.5(f), 4.3(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude warranties and undertakings as to future performance.
3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless additionally agreed, and no such agreement is stated.
7.1.8(b) excludes administrative charges, and the fee also attaches to the excluded data work.
